chose: The mutation runner notifies the live channel just before COMMIT when an attempt wrote any table outside a short list of the service's own tables, read from the statements' text (insert into, update ... set, delete from)
over: a notify per domain write call, or a payload naming the workspace or member
because: the runner already sees every statement, so no domain code can forget; it cannot tell the workspace or member from SQL, and one member's change shows on others' pages, so the payload stays empty and every open view refetches
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: The internal-table list lives in service/src/live.ts as string literals (jobs, crons, archive, flag definitions and refreshes, replays, load state, the analytics tables, Slack receipts and rate limits), pinned by a test that each one exists in the migrated schema
over: importing the schema's table objects, or an exact-equality test of the list
because: R18 forbids importing the schema whole outside two files; an equality test would restate the list, while the existence test catches a rename or typo; an unlisted internal table only costs an extra refetch

because: a retried attempt must notify for its own writes alone; a fenced write that rolled back only over-notifies, which costs one refetch
